### Hi there, I'm Janez 👋

Software engineer with a broad footprint across **backend, web, mobile and devops** —
equally comfortable designing architecture, shipping features and keeping production systems
running. Curious by nature, always experimenting with new technologies, AI, game dev and
side projects, simply because I enjoy building things and figuring out how they work.
Teaching and mentoring others is just as rewarding as writing the code myself — I've run
courses spanning total beginners up to advanced university sessions, and I love helping
people discover that programming can be creative and genuinely fun rather than something
scary. Explaining an idea forces you to understand it more deeply, so mentoring makes me a
better engineer too.

Currently pursuing an MSc in Computer Science at
[FRI, University of Ljubljana](https://www.fri.uni-lj.si/en).

- 📍 Velenje / Ljubljana, Slovenia
- 📧 [janez.sedeljsak@gmail.com](mailto:janez.sedeljsak@gmail.com)

#### 💡 What I do

- **Architecture & code quality** — designing systems that scale cleanly, paired with readable, maintainable code and a habit of improving performance.
- **Frontend & mobile** — React and React Native, API integration, OAuth, PWAs, with a good UI/UX sense shaped by years of design work.
- **Backend & data flows** — ORMs, caching, business logic and toolchains for exports/imports, mindful of query and dataflow optimization.
- **CI/CD tooling** — building and maintaining automated pipelines across GitHub Actions, GitLab, Docker, Rust and Bash.
- **Databases** — comfortable across SQL, NoSQL and Parquet; I've even built my own DBMS, [Graphenix](https://repozitorij.uni-lj.si/IzpisGradiva.php?id=152698&lang=slv).
- **Picking the right tool for the job** — usually favoring the boring, stable option, but going niche when a project calls for it.
